senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) [smooth stone used for casting lots, v.
units: <cite ref="I Samuel 17:40">I Sam. XVII, 40</cite> <he>חַלֻּקֵי</he>; cmp. <cite ref="C00497"><he>גורל</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00328"><he>גווזא</he></cite>; cmp.
Is. XXXIV, 17; Ps. XXII, 19,] lot, share, portion.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 10a">Snh. X </cite>(XI), 1 <he>ח׳ לעו״הב</he> a share in the world to come.
<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:5">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>יהא חֶלְקִי מ־</he> Oh, that my lot fell among &c.; <cite ref="Moed Katan 18b:19">M. Kat. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>יהא חלקי עם</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 312:2">Sifré Deut. 312</cite> <he>תנו לי חֶלְקִי</he> give me my estate (my title) back, v. <cite ref="N00845"><he>נָכַר</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>חֲלָקִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:1">B. Mets. I, 1</cite> <he>שלשה ח׳</he> three portions (fourths).
<cite ref="Shabbat 34b:6">Sabb. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>שלשה חֶלְקֵי מיל</he> three parts of a mile, expl. three fourths; <he>ב׳ ח׳ מיל</he> two thirds; a. fr.
